identification: About 30 genuine Pendelfin (Burnley, England) stonecraft rabbit figures plus a large schoolhouse display piece. Base labels read Barney, Little Hero (Family Circle) and Dandy, all Pendelfin. Condition: worn felt bases, old $10 sticker, no obvious chips in the overview photos.

entries.note: Paid locally, not a resale price. Tray of Pendelfin figures with a limited edition book, much smaller than this lot, no schoolhouse. From the local database, page not opened.

searches_tried: Local comps.py (pipeline and work) for pendelfin, pendelfin schoolhouse, pendelfin figures, with min-price and years filters: one Armitage hit only. Gowans API search for pendelfin returned only the current lot. WebSearch budget was used up, so no web searches ran (3 attempts refused). eBay sold listings for Pendelfin schoolhouse and Pendelfin job lots would settle the value, but eBay is closed to us. No resale evidence found.
chrome_hint: eBay Australia, sold items: 'Pendelfin schoolhouse' and 'Pendelfin rabbits job lot'; also check pendelfin schoolhouse Buy It Now prices and Australian auction results on LiveAuctioneers/Invaluable for 'Pendelfin collection'.
viewing_check: Check the figures closely for chips, cracks, ear repairs and crazing; check the schoolhouse for damage, bell and missing small parts; count the figures and note any rarer or retired models (limited editions, boxed pieces, Pendelfin Family Circle pieces); look at base labels for the oldest Burnley-era marks.
rate_note: No foreign currency prices; no conversion needed.
